## Findings ledger
- [D4.DOC8.F3] The paper qualifies the Weberian state-centered view by treating state-centered and society-centered approaches as historically contingent heuristics rather than general explanations — dim: citation_stance — ref: RW0023 — stance: qualifies — object: the Weberian state-centered view as a general explanation of state–society relations — anchor: "the Weberian state-centered view transcendent." — doc: em:8AX3TFK3 — anchor-b: "Thus, the state-centered and society-centered approaches are best understood as heuristics suggesting certain lines of inquiry whose fruitfulness will depend on the precise historical configuration under discussion." — doc-b: em:8AX3TFK3 — confidence: medium

scope_outcomes.criterion: A retained finding requires an explicit proposition attributed to Weber or to a Weberian position, together with a supported adoption, qualification, dispute, or mention in the citing text.
scope_outcomes.basis: The inspected body explicitly attributes a definition of the state to Weber, characterizes Weberian and neo-Weberian approaches, and qualifies the state-centered approach as a general account.
limitations: The paper does not separately establish the authors’ individual stances within the coauthorship.
The supplied text gives more direct discussion of Weberian traditions than of a sustained close reading of Weber’s original work.
